verdicts.reason: A breaks the product apart: the green circle is cut off at the left edge while the can floats alone at the far right. SOLSTICE is placed under the headline, the CTA is a tiny pill crammed in front of the badges, and the body copy is too small to read. B is a proper leaderboard that reads left to right: the can sits in its circle, SOLSTICE runs above the headline, the copy and badges are in the middle, and a prominent CTA sits at the right. Its flaws are minor: the circle nearly touches the top and bottom edges, and the badges are tight under fairly small body text.
